lines.say: In 1953, one asshole ordered two hundred sixty tons of turkey.
Ten railroad cars, packed with turkey, and Thanksgiving was already over.
Nobody wanted it. Half a million pounds of dead bird, just sitting there.
A salesman named Gerry Thomas saw an airline meal tray and thought, shit, that's it.
He ordered five thousand aluminum trays and filled them with turkey, stuffing, peas, and sweet potatoes.
They called it the TV dinner. Ninety-eight cents.
The next year, they sold over ten million of them.
Same turkey. Nobody wanted it, until it got a new job.
